say:1:1430230401:1.text: What nobility? There are no nobles in Sal'thorin anymore. All the Essail are equal now.
say:1:1430230401:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰现在哪还有贵族？现在提倡艾塞勒平等。
say:1:1430230401:1.male: What nobility? There are no nobles in Sal'thorin anymore. All the Essail are equal now.
say:1:1430230401:1.female: What nobility? There are no nobles in Sal'thorin anymore. All the Essail are equal now.

say:2:1430230402:1.text: With the demise of the Queen, there are no more fools to buy this gilded trash.
say:2:1430230402:1.source_cn: 女王不在后，贵族的那些东西更没有人来买。
say:2:1430230402:1.male: With the demise of the Queen, there are no more fools to buy this gilded trash.
say:2:1430230402:1.female: With the demise of the Queen, there are no more fools to buy this gilded trash.

say:3:1430230403:1.text: Perhaps I should pick up some wares from the surface, bring it down here, and sell it.
say:3:1430230403:1.source_cn: 或许我可以选一些地表的好东西，拿到地下来卖。
say:3:1430230403:1.male: Perhaps I should pick up some wares from the surface, bring it down here, and sell it.
say:3:1430230403:1.female: Perhaps I should pick up some wares from the surface, bring it down here, and sell it.
